```js
5147: function formatBoardroomEuro(value) {
5148:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "" || value === "—") return "—";
5149:   const number = Number(value);
5150:   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return String(value);
5151:   return `€${number.toLocaleString("en-GB", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
5152: }
5153: 
5154: function formatBoardroomPercent(value) {
5155:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "" || value === "—") return "—";
5156:   const number = Number(value);
5157:   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return String(value);
5158:   return `${number.toLocaleString("en-GB", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%`;
5159: }
5160: 
5161: function renderBoardroomMetricCard(label, value, sub = "") {
5162:   return `
5163:     <div class="card aion-boardroom-compact-metric-card">
5164:       <div class="card-label aion-boardroom-compact-metric-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</div>
5165:       <div class="aion-boardroom-compact-metric-line">
5166:         <span class="card-value aion-boardroom-compact-metric-value">${escapeHtml(value)}</span>
5167:         ${sub ? `<span class="card-sub aion-boardroom-compact-metric-sub">${escapeHtml(sub)}</span>` : ""}
5168:       </div>
5169:     </div>
5170:   `;
5171: }
5172: 
5173: function renderBoardroomBindings(bindingsByCategory) {
5174:   const entries = Object.entries(bindingsByCategory || {});
5175:   if (!entries.length) {
5176:     return `<div class="empty-state">No container bindings loaded.</div>`;
5177:   }
5178: 
5179:   return `
5180:     <div class="list-wrap">
5181:       ${entries
5182:         .map(([category, items]) => {
5183:           const count = Array.isArray(items) ? items.length : 0;
5184:           return `
5185:             <div class="list-item">
5186:               <div class="list-item-title">${escapeHtml(category)}</div>
5187:               <div class="list-item-sub">${escapeHtml(count)} binding(s)</div>
5188:             </div>
5189:           `;
```

```js
28302: function renderAionArchitectNodeCanvas() {
28303:   const canvas = getAionArchitectCanvasState();
28304:   const steps = Array.isArray(canvas.steps) ? canvas.steps : [];
28305:   const selectedId = canvas.selectedStepId;
28306: 
28307:   return `
28308:     <section class="aion-architect-real-canvas" data-aion-architect-real-canvas="true">
28309:       <div class="aion-architect-real-canvas-head">
28310:         <div>
28311:           <div class="eyebrow">AI Workflow Architect</div>
28312:           <h2>Build the automation as nodes</h2>
28313:           <p>Click a node to configure it. Use + to add the next step. All execution remains dry-run first.</p>
28314:         </div>
28315: 
28316:         <button type="button" class="secondary-btn" data-aion-architect-open-module-picker="true">
28317:           + Add step
28318:         </button>
28319:       </div>
28320: 
28321:       <div class="aion-architect-node-lane">
28322:         ${steps.map((step, index) => {
28323:           const selected = String(step.id) === String(selectedId);
28324:           const appLabel = step.app || step.connector || "Choose";
28325:           return `
28326:             <div class="aion-architect-node-wrap">
28327:               <button
28328:                 type="button"
28329:                 class="aion-architect-node-card ${selected ? "selected" : ""}"
28330:                 data-aion-architect-select-step="${escapeHtml(step.id)}"
28331:               >
28332:                 <div class="aion-architect-node-icon">${escapeHtml(String(appLabel).slice(0, 1).toUpperCase())}</div>
28333:                 <div class="aion-architect-node-badge">${escapeHtml(String(index + 1))}</div>
28334:                 <strong>${escapeHtml(appLabel)}</strong>
28335:                 <span>${escapeHtml(step.action_label || "Choose action")}</span>
28336:                 <small>${escapeHtml(step.subtitle || step.action_id || "Configure this step")}</small>
28337:               </button>
28338: 
```
```js
28339:               <div class="aion-architect-node-mini-toolbar">
28340:                 <button type="button" title="Step settings" data-aion-architect-open-settings="${escapeHtml(step.id)}">⚙</button>
28341:                 <button type="button" title="Configure logic / variables" data-aion-architect-open-advanced-config="${escapeHtml(step.id)}">⑂</button>
28342:                 <button type="button" title="Remove step" aria-label="Remove step" data-aion-architect-remove-step="${escapeHtml(step.id)}">×</button>
28343:               </div>
28344:             </div>
28345: 
28346:             ${index < steps.length - 1 ? `<div class="aion-architect-node-link"></div>` : ""}
28347:           `;
28348:         }).join("")}
28349: 
28350:         <button type="button" class="aion-architect-add-step-node" data-aion-architect-open-module-picker="true">
28351:           +
28352:         </button>
28353:       </div>
28354:     </section>
28355:   `;
28356: }
```

```js
54559: function fitAionWorkflowCanvasToGeneratedGraph_DISABLED_DUPLICATE(graph) {
54560:   const nodes = Array.isArray(graph?.nodes) ? graph.nodes : [];
54561:   if (!nodes.length) return;
54562: 
54563:   const xs = nodes.map((node) => Number(node.x || node.position?.x || 0));
54564:   const ys = nodes.map((node) => Number(node.y || node.position?.y || 0));
54565: 
54566:   const minX = Math.min(...xs);
54567:   const maxX = Math.max(...xs);
54568:   const minY = Math.min(...ys);
54569:   const maxY = Math.max(...ys);
54570: 
54571:   const width = Math.max(1, maxX - minX + 420);
54572:   const height = Math.max(1, maxY - minY + 320);
54573: 
54574:   const shell = document.querySelector(".aion-workflow-canvas-shell") ||
54575:     document.querySelector(".aion-workflow-canvas");
54576: 
54577:   const viewportWidth = Number(shell?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth || 1400);
54578:   const viewportHeight = Number(shell?.clientHeight || window.innerHeight || 800);
54579: 
54580:   const zoomX = viewportWidth / width;
54581:   const zoomY = viewportHeight / height;
54582:   const zoom = Math.max(0.48, Math.min(0.95, Math.min(zoomX, zoomY)));
54583: 
54584:   window.__aionWorkflowZoom = zoom;
54585:   window.__aionWorkflowPan = {
54586:     x: Math.round(140 - minX * zoom),
54587:     y: Math.round(130 - minY * zoom),
54588:   };
54589: 
54590:   if (typeof updateAionWorkflowCanvasTransform === "function") {
54591:     updateAionWorkflowCanvasTransform();
54592:   }
54593: }
```

```js
68142: (function installAionMainNodeEditorAiSettingsV5() {
```

```js
70334: /* AION PATCH: final mini-toolbar delete hitbox fix v1
70335:    Root cause:
70336:    The visible X can be rendered but click target falls through to the node,
70337:    so the node is selected instead of deleted.
70338:    Fix:
70339:    Force mini-toolbar hitboxes above the node and handle delete from pointerdown/click.
70340: */
70341: (function installAionMiniToolbarDeleteHitboxFixV1() {
70342:   const PATCH_ID = "aion-mini-toolbar-delete-hitbox-fix-v1";
70343:   if (document.getElementById(PATCH_ID)) return;
70344: 
70345:   function getGraph() {
70346:     try {
70347:       if (typeof getAionWorkflowDraftState === "function") return getAionWorkflowDraftState();
70348:     } catch (_) {}
70349: 
70350:     return window.__aionWorkflowGraph || null;
70351:   }
70352: 
70353:   function deleteNodeById(nodeId) {
70354:     if (!nodeId) return false;
70355: 
70356:     const graph = getGraph();
70357:     if (!graph || !Array.isArray(graph.nodes)) return false;
70358: 
70359:     const before = graph.nodes.length;
70360: 
70361:     graph.nodes = graph.nodes.filter((node) => String(node.id) !== String(nodeId));
70362:     graph.edges = Array.isArray(graph.edges)
70363:       ? graph.edges.filter((edge) => {
70364:           const from = edge.from || edge.source;
70365:           const to = edge.to || edge.target;
70366:           return String(from) !== String(nodeId) && String(to) !== String(nodeId);
70367:         })
70368:       : [];
70369: 
70370:     if (graph.nodes.length === before) return false;
70371: 
70372:     graph.dirty = true;
70373:     window["__aionWorkflowGraph"] = graph;
70374: 
70375:     if (window.__aionWorkflowSelectedNodeId === nodeId) {
70376:       window.__aionWorkflowSelectedNodeId =
70377:         graph.nodes[graph.nodes.length - 1]?.id || graph.nodes[0]?.id || null;
70378:     }
70379: 
70380:     try {
70381:       if (typeof compileAndAttachAionWorkflowGlyph === "function") {
70382:         compileAndAttachAionWorkflowGlyph(graph);
70383:       }
70384:     } catch (_) {}
70385: 
70386:     try {
70387:       if (typeof persistAionWorkflowDraftState === "function") {
70388:         persistAionWorkflowDraftState();
70389:       }
70390:     } catch (_) {}
70391: 
70392:     try {
70393:       window.localStorage?.setItem(
70394:         "aion.workflow.draft.v1",
70395:         JSON.stringify(graph),
70396:       );
70397:     } catch (_) {}
70398: 
70399:     console.log("[aion-delete-final] deleted", nodeId, graph.nodes.map((n) => n.id));
70400: 
70401:     if (!window.__aionDraggingConnector && typeof requestRender === "function") requestRender();
70402:     return true;
70403:   }
70404: 
70405:   function findDeleteTarget(event) {
70406:     const direct = event.target.closest?.('[data-aion-main-node-toolbar="delete"]');
70407:     if (direct) return direct;
70408: 
70409:     const path = typeof event.composedPath === "function" ? event.composedPath() : [];
70410:     return path.find?.(
70411:       (el) =>
70412:         el?.getAttribute?.("data-aion-main-node-toolbar") === "delete",
70413:     );
70414:   }
70415: 
70416:   function handleDelete(event) {
70417:     const deleteTarget = findDeleteTarget(event);
70418:     if (!deleteTarget) return;
70419: 
70420:     event.preventDefault();
70421:     event.stopPropagation();
70422:     event.stopImmediatePropagation();
70423: 
70424:     const nodeId =
70425:       deleteTarget.getAttribute("data-aion-main-node-toolbar-node") ||
70426:       deleteTarget.closest?.("[data-aion-workflow-node-id]")?.getAttribute("data-aion-workflow-node-id");
70427: 
70428:     deleteNodeById(nodeId);
70429:   }
70430: 
70431:   document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handleDelete, true);
70432:   document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleDelete, true);
```

```js
70473:    node editor modal as double-clicking the node.
70474: */
70475: (function installAionMiniToolbarSettingsOpensNodeEditorV1() {
70476:   const PATCH_ID = "aion-mini-toolbar-settings-opens-node-editor-v1";
70477:   if (document.getElementById(PATCH_ID)) return;
70478: 
70479:   function getSettingsTarget(event) {
70480:     const direct = event.target.closest?.('[data-aion-main-node-toolbar="settings"]');
70481:     if (direct) return direct;
70482: 
70483:     const path = typeof event.composedPath === "function" ? event.composedPath() : [];
70484:     return path.find?.(
70485:       (el) => el?.getAttribute?.("data-aion-main-node-toolbar") === "settings",
70486:     );
70487:   }
70488: 
70489:   function openNodeEditorFromSettings(settingsTarget) {
70490:     if (!settingsTarget) return false;
70491: 
70492:     const nodeId =
70493:       settingsTarget.getAttribute("data-aion-main-node-toolbar-node") ||
70494:       settingsTarget.closest?.("[data-aion-workflow-node-id]")?.getAttribute("data-aion-workflow-node-id");
70495: 
70496:     if (!nodeId) return false;
70497: 
70498:     window.__aionWorkflowSelectedNodeId = nodeId;
70499: 
70500:     const safeId = window.CSS?.escape ? CSS.escape(nodeId) : nodeId;
70501:     const nodeEl = document.querySelector(`[data-aion-workflow-node-id="${safeId}"]`);
70502: 
70503:     if (!nodeEl) return false;
70504:

70506:     // the real Input / Parameters / Output modal.
70507:     nodeEl.dispatchEvent(
70508:       new MouseEvent("dblclick", {
70509:         bubbles: true,
70510:         cancelable: true,
70511:         view: window,
70512:       }),
70513:     );
70514: 
70515:     return true;
70516:   }
70517: 
70518:   function handleSettings(event) {
70519:     const settingsTarget = getSettingsTarget(event);
70520:     if (!settingsTarget) return;
70521: 
70522:     event.preventDefault();
70523:     event.stopPropagation();
70524:     event.stopImmediatePropagation();
70525: 
70526:     openNodeEditorFromSettings(settingsTarget);
70527:   }

70529:   document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handleSettings, true);
70530:   document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleSettings, true);
70531:   document.addEventListener("click", handleSettings, true);
70532:

70534:   style.id = PATCH_ID;
70535:   style.textContent = `
```
